sn_aia_skill_metadata.description: Gives a people manager a prioritised brief of what needs attention in their team this week: overdue and due-soon follow-up actions, manager support requests waiting for approval, upcoming birthdays, work anniversaries and joiners, missing HR information, and journeys at risk. Use when a manager asks what to focus on, what is overdue, or how their team is doing.
sn_aia_skill_metadata.name: Manager Team Brief
